node.title: Uncontrolled Memory Allocation
node.author: Rishi2Monk
node.doctext:
Checkmarx, a static analyzer tool is throwing security issue with the below code, saying that $file_list is accessing Uncontrolled Memory Allocation.

open ( INFILE, "<", "$inputfile" ) || die( "Cannot read list file $inputfile" ); while ( ) { $file = $_; chomp ( $file ); $file_list{$file} = "1"; }

I tried to restrict the size of the hash variable as mentioned below but the error is not resolved.

if(length($file) <= (1 * 1024 * 1024)) { $file_list{$file} = "1"; } Kindly help me to understand the reason as the above code looks ok to me.
